title: ICC prosecutors seek to admit 3 more witness accounts in Duterte trial

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution in former President Rodrigo Duterte’s crimes against humanity case before the International Criminal Court (ICC) has sought to admit the recorded testimonies of three more witnesses as evidence to expedite the proceedings. Based on a 12-page copy of the prosecution’s application made public on Thursday (Manila time), the panel said the recorded testimonies of the three witnesses, identified as “P-0008,” “P-1164” and “P-1303,” “are relevant, reliable and probative” to the case.
